title: Degree of the encoded polynomial
statement: Let $\ell,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let a certified irreducible binary field modulus of degree $\ell$ be fixed, and let $\gamma$ be a length-$n$ vector over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Form the polynomial over the quotient field by adjoining a root of that modulus, whose coefficient of $X^{i+1}$ is the image of $\gamma_i$. Its natural degree is at most $n$.
hypotheses_covered: A certified binary field implementation of degree ℓ, including irreducibility of its modulus
